title: Access Log Information Model
description: openEHR Access Log Information Model specification (draft)
micro_summary: Record of every access to EHR data
summary: Model of the record an EHR system keeps of every access to EHR data: who accessed, on whose behalf, what, when, why, under which authorisation, with which outcome and through which channel. The log is kept beside the EHR, keyed by ehr_id, append-only and hash-chained, with tombstones that keep the chain intact after retention, signed checkpoints, a subject view for the patient, ITS-REST resources and an AQL root class.
